follow-up time: Variable, up to the resolution of T2 hyperintense PSES thickening
outcome: presence and resolution of T2 hyperintense thickening of the cervical/thoracic posterior spinal epidural space (PSES) on MRI
cohort: 93 newborns within the first 2 weeks of life who underwent spinal/cranial MRI
finding: T2 hyperintense PSES thickening is a common and reversible finding in newborns, with no significant associations with birth-related factors or neurologic outcomes.
mod_finding: No difference was found in the occurrence of T2 hyperintense PSES thickening between different birth methods (p>0.05).
followup_time: Within the first 2 weeks of life
